ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) background with approximately 10-15% coverage of high-intensity (white) punctate pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white circular blobs scattered across the distal and medial regions of both fluke lobes, with higher densities along the trailing edges and lower density in the central peduncle region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate 80-85 degree vertex angle and shallow vertical penetration relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; micro-peaks (2-5 pixel amplitude) are visible, becoming significantly more jagged and pronounced at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to a distinct upward-sloping sweep at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups (3-12 pixels in diameter) distributed across the ventral surface, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.
